answer: The forge schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the delta checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 73 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. An adversary wanting 71 effective identities must lock that capital for 73 epochs and keep it locked through every yarrow audit. That is 14 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
